core_questions.wording: What does a typical busy week look like for you?
Can you tell me about a recent time when two things competed for the same time? What did you decide to do?
Are there things on your calendar that you try especially hard not to move?
When someone asks for your time at the last minute, what usually affects whether you say yes?
What makes a week feel successful or worthwhile to you?
When you have to move or cancel something, what concerns you most?

approved_followups.wording: What made that important to you?
What felt hardest to give up in that situation?
Is that usually how you handle similar situations?
What would have happened if you had chosen differently?
